Fit a penalized composite link model

Source: R/harmonise-pclm.R
pclm_fit.Rd

Latent values gamma = exp(B beta) on a fine grid are linked to observed counts by mu = C (o * gamma), where o is an offset (exposures for rates, interval widths for counts). The coefficients are estimated by penalized Poisson IRLS; the smoothing parameter is chosen by BIC or AIC on a log scale unless fixed.

Usage

pclm_fit(
  y,
  C,
  o,
  B,
  pen,
  lambda = NULL,
  criterion = c("bic", "aic"),
  lambda_range = c(0.01, 1e+08),
  beta = NULL
)

Arguments

y

Observed counts.

C

Composite link matrix (observations x fine cells), dense or sparse.

o

Offset per fine cell.

B

Basis matrix (fine cells x coefficients), or a tensor basis over fine ages and periods from pclm_tensor(), whose products are computed in array form (Currie, Durban and Eilers 2006).

pen

List of penalty matrices (one per smoothing parameter).

lambda

Fixed smoothing parameters, or NULL to select them.

criterion

"bic" or "aic".

lambda_range

Search range for each smoothing parameter.

beta

Optional starting values.

Value

A list with gamma, beta, mu (fitted observed counts), lambda, ed (effective dimension), dev, ic, se_eta, converged and at_bound.

References

Currie ID, Durban M, Eilers PHC (2006). Generalized linear array models with applications to multidimensional smoothing. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B 68(2): 259-280. doi:10.1111/j.1467-9868.2006.00543.x
